_doc: Gap register (tier-4 §5). Append-only, one JSON object per line. Fields: asset, gap_id, criterion, what (what is wrong), change (the fix), detector (query/test/script that closes it), owner, gate (what it blocks; default = this asset certification), state (OPEN|IN_PROGRESS|CLOSED|WITHDRAWN), ts. A gap with no detector is not registered — it is raised as a question.
